thread:
alex: quick help — AcmeCo's private VPC onboarding: their Grafana datasource stopped showing new metrics after they changed subnets. Anything quick to triage?

maria: first check: can their Prometheus (or push gateway) reach our OTLP/remote_write endpoint? ask them to curl the health URL and share output.

jonah: also ask for the grafana datasource config (URL + auth type). sometimes remote_write is ok but grafana datasource uses the wrong tenant header.

alex: got a log from them: 
```
level=error msg="remote_write failed" err="400 Bad Request: missing tenant" tenant=""
```

maria: yup — that matches tenant header missing. For private/VPC customers they must include X-Redwood-Tenant or use the API key header depending on setup. If they're using Prometheus remote_write, add this to the write config: 
```
remote_write:
  - url: https://priv-otlp.prod.redwood.internal/api/v1/remote_write
    headers:
      X-Redwood-Tenant: "acct-acmeco"
      Authorization: "Bearer <token-if-needed>"
```

jonah: quick network checklist: 1) confirm egress to our gateway (443) from their scrape hosts, 2) check any NAT/GW route table changed by the subnet update, 3) ensure security groups allow ephemeral return traffic.

alex: thanks — I'm pinging their infra lead to add header + run a curl: 
```
curl -i -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: acct-acmeco" -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" https://priv-otlp.prod.redwood.internal/health
```

maria: if curl still 400, paste the raw request headers from their Prom config (we can tell if the remote_write client strips headers) or check if they use a proxy that drops custom headers.

srebot: deploy: otlp-gateway v2.14.1 rolled out to priv cluster eu-west-1 at 2026-03-07T05:12:00Z :rocket:

jonah: also check grafana: datasource type should be "Prometheus (remote read/write)" or them pointing to our query API endpoint. If they rely on a sidecar that scrapes locally, make sure it forwards to the right tenant.

alex: will follow up once they reply. tagging @maria and @jonah for visibility, thanks. :thumbsup:
